# Introduction

The raw dataset contains `r nrow(churn_raw)` records and `r ncol(churn_raw)` variables.

# Data Overview

The raw dataset consists of `r nrow(churn_raw)` records and `r ncol(churn_raw)` variables, of which `r sum(sapply(churn_raw, is.numeric))` are quantitative and `r sum(sapply(churn_raw, is.character))` are categorical. Detailed information on the variables and their data types is provided in @tbl-raw-data-types.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-raw-data-types
#| tbl-cap: 'Variables, their types and number of missing records in the raw dataset.'
#| cap-location: bottom
#| layout-ncol: 2

df_tbl <- data.frame(
  name = names(churn_raw),
  type = sapply(churn_raw, class),
  NAs = sapply(churn_raw, function(var) sum(is.na(var)))
)

n <- ceiling(nrow(df_tbl) / 2)
df1 <- df_tbl[1:n, ]
df2 <- df_tbl[(n + 1):nrow(df_tbl), ]

create_simple_table(df1, c('Variable', 'Type', 'NAs'))
create_simple_table(df2, c('Variable', 'Type', 'NAs'))
```

In total, the dataset contains `r sum(is.na(churn_raw))` missing values, all of them in the `TotalCharges` variable. How these records were handled is described in @sec-cleaning.
